item.name: Module 5 - API Gateways
item.description: Requests demonstrated in the API Gateways module, routed through the Spring Cloud Gateway on port 8888.

item.name: Gateway Filters and Cross-Cutting Concerns
item.description: Requests sent through the gateway to exercise the built-in and body-modification filters.

request.description: GET through the gateway: RewritePath strips the /api prefix so the backend receives /campaigns, AddRequestHeader stamps X-Source on the forwarded request, and ModifyResponseBody wraps the campaign list in a {"source":"gateway","data":[...]} envelope.
POST through the gateway with sender left null: the ModifyRequestBody filter rewrites the payload before it reaches the backend, so the echoed response shows sender set to "gateway".
